paper_title: STEMing evidence-based study strategies: a systematic review of literature
finding: Regular active recall distributed over intervals significantly improves retention and academic outcomes in STEM
measurement: Academic exam scores and retention metrics
practical_implication: Implement spaced active recall prompts and quiz intervals instead of passive reading timers
limitation: Studies primarily evaluated single courses rather than multi-year knowledge durability

paper_title: STEMing evidence-based study strategies: a systematic review of literature
finding: Mixing diverse problem categories during practice enhances problem discrimination and categorization skills
practical_implication: Provide session recommendation to alternate between related topics or difficulty levels
limitation: Less frequently adopted voluntarily due to higher subjective difficulty perceived by students

paper_title: STEMing evidence-based study strategies: a systematic review of literature
finding: Passive review produces illusory fluency without deep schema construction and suffers rapid forgetting
practical_implication: Add actionable nudges warning users when a session is purely passive reading without self-testing
limitation: Subjective habit change requires external scaffolding and is resisted by learners

paper_title: STEMing evidence-based study strategies: a systematic review of literature
finding: Students rarely adopt effortful learning strategies voluntarily unless prompted or incentivized by external structures
measurement: Course participation and assignment completion rates
practical_implication: Burnout Radarr should scaffold habit changes with low-friction automated check-ins rather than assuming self-driven adoption
limitation: Extrinsic motivation may diminish once external course requirements end

paper_title: Mentally Demanding Work and Strain: Effects of Study Duration on Fatigue, Vigor, and Distress in Undergraduate Medical Students
finding: Preceding day study duration of 1-4h does not significantly increase next-day acute fatigue compared to rest days (p > 0.05)
practical_implication: Establish a safe cognitive window of 3-4 hours daily intensive study before triggering high fatigue warnings
limitation: Observational diary data; self-reported hours without objective digital telemetry

paper_title: Mentally Demanding Work and Strain: Effects of Study Duration on Fatigue, Vigor, and Distress in Undergraduate Medical Students
behaviour: Studying 5-6 hours or greater than 6 hours per day
finding: Preceding day study duration exceeding 4-6h causes steep statistically significant increases in next-day fatigue (5-6h: p = 0.009; >6h: p < 0.001; Wald chi2 = 26.3)
practical_implication: Trigger caution alerts when daily session timer passes 4 hours and strong fatigue warnings at 6+ hours
limitation: Sample comprised 69.4% female Austrian medical students; limits cross-cultural generalization

paper_title: Mentally Demanding Work and Strain: Effects of Study Duration on Fatigue, Vigor, and Distress in Undergraduate Medical Students
behaviour: Studying 1-2 hours or more vs rest days
finding: Even modest study duration (1-2h) significantly elevates next-day psychological distress compared to 0h rest days (p = 0.004; Wald chi2 = 44.2)
practical_implication: Recommend full rest days (0h study) during prolonged exam preparation to reset baseline psychological distress
limitation: Does not establish clinical anxiety; measures daily subjective distress fluctuations

paper_title: Mentally Demanding Work and Strain: Effects of Study Duration on Fatigue, Vigor, and Distress in Undergraduate Medical Students
finding: Prior day study duration has no significant predictive relationship with next-day vigor (p = 0.713; Wald chi2 = 2.124)
practical_implication: Do not treat high morning vigor as proof that the user is not suffering from accumulated fatigue
limitation: Fatigue and vigor are distinct orthogonal constructs rather than bipolar opposites

paper_title: Mentally Demanding Work and Strain: Effects of Study Duration on Fatigue, Vigor, and Distress in Undergraduate Medical Students
finding: Proximity to exam strongly increases distress (p < 0.001) and fatigue (p < 0.05) and suppresses vigor (p < 0.05) following a non-linear power curve
practical_implication: Incorporate days-until-deadline into CFI and adjust recommendations toward lighter review near test dates
limitation: Specific to high-stakes comprehensive exam countdown period

paper_title: Mentally Demanding Work and Strain: Effects of Study Duration on Fatigue, Vigor, and Distress in Undergraduate Medical Students
finding: Longer sleep duration significantly attenuates morning fatigue (p < 0.01)
practical_implication: Add sleep duration check-in as a critical recovery buffer metric in daily CFI calculations
limitation: Sleep quality and architecture were not measured with polysomnography

paper_title: Measuring the cognitive load of software developers: An extended Systematic Mapping Study
finding: EEG was used in 55% of primary studies to assess cognitive load via theta synchronization and alpha suppression
practical_implication: Neuro-physiological monitoring provides strong laboratory validation but is impractical for standard consumer IDEs
limitation: High sensitivity to motion artifacts and electrode displacement in non-laboratory settings

paper_title: Measuring the cognitive load of software developers: An extended Systematic Mapping Study
finding: NASA-TLX is the primary validated subjective instrument for capturing developer mental demand and frustration
practical_implication: Design developer post-session check-ins using simplified NASA-TLX dimensions (Mental Demand and Frustration)
limitation: Subjective post-hoc reflection can introduce retrospective recall bias

paper_title: Measuring the cognitive load of software developers: An extended Systematic Mapping Study
finding: Code comprehension and debugging represent 48% to 83% of tasks and generate highest working-memory load and frustration
measurement: Task completion time and cognitive load indices
practical_implication: Weight debugging and comprehension sessions higher in cognitive load and recommend shorter session durations
limitation: Primary studies used small lab code snippets rather than massive enterprise codebases

paper_title: Measuring the cognitive load of software developers: An extended Systematic Mapping Study
finding: 51% of studies applied ML classifiers but models suffer severe precision drops in realistic non-laboratory settings
practical_implication: Rely on transparent rule-based heuristics and user check-ins rather than brittle black-box predictive models
limitation: Real-world telemetry faces noise from multi-monitors lighting and physical movement

paper_title: Measuring the cognitive load of software developers: An extended Systematic Mapping Study
finding: Context switching disrupts working memory models of code and increases extraneous cognitive load and error rates
measurement: Mental workload index and bug insertion rate
practical_implication: Encourage protected 45-90 minute deep work blocks for coding and recommend break boundaries at logical checkpoints
limitation: Laboratory experiments often simulate artificial interruptions with varied realism
